tasks.title: Run integrated browser, accessibility and operations review
tasks.summary: Exercise the root workflow in Chromium against local Supabase with synthetic identities; keep unrelated hosted and human release checks explicitly incomplete.
acceptance: The root workflow widget regression remains fast synthetic HTTP evidence. A separate real Chromium test against local Supabase covers registrar create, authorized congregation assignment and conversion follow-up, minimal referral, explicit student link, class enrollment, roster and finalized attendance. Forged cross-scope reads/writes and revocation of the authoritative user_access assignment are denied through the local app HTTP path with unchanged database state.

The browser runner reads local Supabase status, rejects any non-loopback API/database URL before network or SQL work, provisions unique synthetic identities/data, keeps service_role host-side, and cleans up only its own fixture IDs on success or failure.

The runner bypasses proxy environment settings and rejects HTTP redirects; database targets reject multi-host URLs, hostaddr and service-file/connection-option overrides. The local revocation control binds to loopback, requires an unpredictable per-run capability and exact Origin, and can revoke only the known fixture assignment; missing credentials, wrong Origin and arbitrary target IDs are denied.

After attendance is finalized, the production attendance route's immediate _open() refresh shows the frozen roster, a fresh production MinistryRepository/client reads persisted progress, and an app HTTP edit-after-finalize request is denied without changing stored attendance.

Record Chromium end-to-end and Firefox/WebKit smoke versions or incomplete markers; inspect 360/768/1440, 200% text, keyboard, screen reader, reduced motion and contrast with severity-ranked findings.

Release runbook covers Supabase/static-host IAM, encryption, monitoring/Free-tier budget, database plus Storage backup and restore, hosted deep links, OAuth/Storage HTTP and Android device/signing checks.
Whole-product review and actual gate outputs have no unclassified failures; incomplete live release checks remain explicitly incomplete.
